Ex: She was motivated solely by self-interest.

sober

(adjective). điềm đạm, chín chắn

Ex: He is honest, sober and hard-working.

setting

(noun). khung cảnh

Ex: It was the perfect setting for a wonderful Christmas.

reverse

(verb). đảo ngược lại

Ex: The government has failed to reverse the economic decline.

relatively

(adjective). vừa phải, tương đối

Ex: I found the test relatively easy.

prime

(adjective). chủ yếu, căn bản

Ex: My prime concern is to protect my property.

precisely

(adverb). Chính xác, rõ ràng

Ex: They look precisely the same to me.

precipitation

(noun). mưa

Ex: There is heavy precipitation in some parts of the country.

pose

(verb). đặt ra

Ex: Obesity poses real risks to health and happiness.

phenomenon

(noun). hiện tượng

Ex: Globalization is a phenomenon of the 21st century.

persistent

(adjective). bền bỉ, kiên định

Ex: She can be very persistent when she wants something.

paradox

(noun). nghịch lý

Ex: It is a curious paradox that professional comedians often have unhappy personal lives.

mounting

(adjective). tăng lên

Ex: mounting excitement/concern/tension Ex: There is mounting evidence of serious effects on people's health.

migrate

(verb). Di cư

Ex: These animals migrate annually in search of food.

instrumental

(adjective). là phương tiện để làm gì

Ex: The Conservation Trust performs an instrumental role in the protection of rural environments.

immortalise

(verb). Làm cho trở nên trường tồn, bất tử

Ex: Marlene Dietrich was immortalized through her roles in films like "The Blue Angel".

huge

(adjective). to lớn

Ex: A huge crowd had gathered in the square.

grim

(adjective). tàn nhẫn, làm chán nản

Ex: We face the grim prospect of still higher unemployment.

frigid

(adjective). lạnh lẽo, băng giá

Ex: They travelled over frigid lands.

extinction

(noun). Sự tuyệt chủng

Ex:The island's way of life is doomed to extinction.

expense

(noun). phí tổn, chi phí

Ex: The garden was transformed at great expense.

evidence

(noun). Bằng chứng

Ex: Researchers have found clear scientific evidence of a link between exposure to sun and skin cancer.

equivalent

(noun). vật tương đương

Ex: Send €20 or the equivalent in your own currency.

entail

(verb). đòi hỏi, gây ra

Ex: They learn exactly what is entailed in caring for a newborn baby.

dwindle

(verb). thu nhỏ lại, giảm

Ex: Support for the party has dwindled away to nothing

distressed

(adjective). đau buồn

Ex: He was too distressed and confused to answer their questions.

disruption

(noun). Sự gián đoạn

Ex: The accident brought widespread disruption on the roads.

devastating

(adjective). Mang tính tàn phá

Ex: He received devastating injuries in the accident.

commonplace

(adjective). Phổ biến

Ex: This technology is now commonplace in schools.

attack

(verb). tấn công

Ex: Most wild animals won't attack unless they are provoked.

accelerate

(verb). gia tăng, làm nhanh lên

Ex: Exposure to the sun can accelerate the ageing process.

peruse

(verb). nghiên cứu, xem xét kỹ

Ex: A copy of the report is available for you to peruse at your leisure.

illustrate

(verb). Minh hoạ

Ex: He is showing these silent films to help illustrate his story of survival.

depict

(verb). Diễn tả

Ex: Her paintings depict the lives of ordinary people in the last century.

colonial

(adjective). thuộc địa

Ex: Tunisia achieved independence from French colonial rule in 1956.

temperate

(adjective). Ôn hoà

Ex: a country with a temperate climate Ex: Chile has one of the largest temperate forests in the southern hemisphere.

ripe

(adjective). chín muồi

Ex: The conditions were ripe for social change.

prolonged

(adjective). kéo dài

Ex: In many parts of the country, frosts were severe and prolonged.

masterpiece

(noun). tuyệt tác

Ex: Leonardo's "Last Supper" is widely regarded as a masterpiece.

hemisphere

(noun). Bán cầu

Ex: Countries in both the Northern and Southern hemispheres continue to treat the world's rivers, seas and oceans as dumping grounds.

drop

(verb). giảm

Ex: The water level in the flooded region has finally begun to drop.

cover

(verb). bao phủ

Ex: Snow covered the ground.

brutal

(adjective). tàn bạo

Ex: The attacks on the crew were quite brutal.

predict

(verb). Dự đoán

Ex: Nobody could predict the outcome.

tribe

(noun). bộ lạc

Ex: The Arunta are an aboriginal tribe from central Australia.

tense

(adjective). gây căng thẳng

Ex: I spent a tense few weeks waiting for the results of the tests.

survival

(noun). sự sinh tồn

Ex: Exporting is necessary for our economic survival.

rapid

(adjective). Nhanh chóng

Ex: The patient made a rapid recovery.

previous

(adjective). trước

Ex: No previous experience is necessary for this job.

politics

(noun). chính trị

Ex: She is aiming for a career in politics.

option

(noun). Phương án, sự lựa chọn

Ex: We are currently studying all the options available.

migration

(noun). Di cư

Ex: Scientists track bird populations and migration patterns.

extensive

(adjective). bao quát, rộng rãi

Ex: Extensive research has been done into this disease.

border

(noun). Biên giới

Ex:I live in a small town in the US, near the Canadian border.

abrupt

(noun). Đột ngột

Ex: The accident brought his career to an abrupt end.

yield

(verb). sản xuất, mang lại

Ex: The research has yielded useful information.

surrender

(verb). đầu hàng

Ex: The rebel soldiers were forced to surrender.

subvert

(verb). phá vỡ, phá hoại

Ex: Our best intentions are sometimes subverted by our natural tendency to selfishness.

prevailing

(adjective). Thịnh hành

Ex: The prevailing view seems to be that they will find her guilty.

penetration

(noun). sự xuyên qua, sự thấm vào

Ex: The floor is sealed to prevent water penetration.

latitude

(noun). vĩ độ

Ex: At these latitudes the sun does not rise at all on winter days.

continental

(adjective). Mang phong cách lục địa Châu Âu

Ex: Visitors can indulge in Indian, Chinese or Continental cuisine as well as delights from the bakery.

threat

(noun). Mối đe dọa

Ex: Many wild plants are under threat of extinction.

take something seriously

(phrase). xem trọng

Ex: Headaches in young children should always be taken seriously.

prepared

(adjective). sẵn sàng

Ex: I was not prepared for all the problems it caused.

alarmed

(adjective). lo sợ

Ex: She was alarmed at the prospect of travelling alone.

vast

(adjective). rộng lớn

Ex: In the vast majority of cases, this should not be a problem.

peg

(verb). ghìm không cho lên xuống

Ex: The agreement works because member nations haven't tried to peg prices.

loss

(noun). mất mát

Ex: He suffered a loss of confidence.

inevitable

(adjective). Không thể tránh khỏi

Ex: They came to see defeat as inevitable.

incalculable

(adjective). không đếm xuể

Ex: The treasures are of incalculable value.

ecology

(noun). Ngành sinh thái học

Ex: We were leaning about ecology in our biology class and this involved a trip to Dublin Zoo.

damage

(noun). tổn hại

Ex: The fire has caused severe damage to the building.

catastrophic

(adjective). thảm họa

Ex: A catastrophic storm made landfall on US soil.

reproduction

(noun). bản sao chép

Ex: They have a catalogue with colour reproductions of the paintings for sale.

oarsman

(noun). tay chèo

Ex: Seen through the door in the background, a team of black oarsmen propel the boat along the Nile.

bash

(verb). đánh mạnh

Ex: He bashed his arm against a shelf.

actually

(adverb). thực sự

Ex: There are lots of people there who can actually help you.

indeed

(adverb). thật vậy, hiển nhiên

Ex: Thank you very much indeed!

explain

(verb). giải thích

Ex: He was trying to explain the difference between hip hop and rap.

culprit

(noun). thủ phạm

Ex: The main culprit in the current crisis seems to be modern farming techniques.

connect

(verb). liên kết, liên tưởng

Ex: Bad diet is closely connected with many common illnesses.

cluttered

(adjective). bừa bộn, lộn xộn

Ex: Her desk was cluttered with papers.

term

(verb). gọi, đặt tên là

Ex: His research focuses on what he loosely terms ‘African ceremonies’.

salinity

(noun). Độ mặn

Ex: Tidal action increases the salinity upstream during the dry season.

oceanographer

(noun). nhà hải dương học

Ex: ‘We can inspire the next generation of oceanographers and marine biologists,’ she said.

drop

(noun). sự giảm

Ex: The recent drop in magazine subscriptions is causing some concern.

alert

(verb). cảnh báo

Ex: They had been alerted to the possibility of further price rises.

alarm

(noun). báo động

Ex: The first two bomb alerts were false alarms, but the third was for real.

adjoin

(verb). nối liền

Ex: It's at this point that these three neighbourhoods adjoin.

tropical

(adjective). thuộc về nhiệt đới

Ex: The Amazon river basin contains the world's largest tropical rainforest.

heat

(noun). nhiệt

Ex: He could feel the heat of the sun on his back.

process

(noun). Quá trình

Ex: Repeat this process until the entire area is tiled.

circulation

(noun). tuần hoàn

Ex: Rapid data circulation through digital information systems means that distance appears to shrink and time seems to collapse.

sink

(verb). chìm

Ex: The legs of the garden chair sank into the soft ground.

dense

(adjective). Dày đặc

Ex: The forest is quite dense at that point.

massive

(adjective). to lớn

Ex: The government put massive amounts of money into the health service.

cascade

(verb). đổ xuống như thác

Ex: Water cascaded down the mountainside.

fresh

(adjective). nước ngọt

Ex: These plants are found in fresh water lakes and rivers.

carry

(verb). mang, đem

Ex: He was carrying a large bag.

sections.title: Passage 3: The Fruit Book
sections.html:
wholesale

(adverb). bán buôn, bán sỉ

Ex: We buy the building materials wholesale.

valuable

(adjective). quý giá

Ex: You should gain some valuable insights into the world of business.

thesis

(noun). luận đề, luận cương

Ex: These latest findings support the thesis that sexuality is determined by nature rather than choice.

tactic

(noun). cách, mẹo, thủ thuật

Ex: They tried all kinds of tactics to get us to go.

suspicious

(adjective). hoài nghi

Ex: They became suspicious of his behaviour and contacted the police.

succumb

(verb). chịu thua

Ex: She succumbed to the temptation of another drink.

revenue

(noun). doanh thu, kết quả kinh doanh

Ex: The government is currently facing a shortfall in tax revenue.

request

(noun). lời thỉnh cầu, lời yêu cầu

Ex: They made a request for further aid.

remarkably

(adverb). đáng chú ý

Ex: The car is in remarkably good condition for its age.

prove

(verb). Chứng minh

Ex: She was determined to prove everyone wrong.

primary

(adjective). chính

Ex: The primary aim of this course is to improve your spoken English.

present

(verb). đưa ra, bày ra

Ex: Are you presenting a paper at the conference?

persuade

(verb). thuyết phục

Ex: She's always easily persuaded.

peasant

(noun). Người nông dân

Ex: a peasant family Ex: Peasant women with scarves around their heads were working in the fields.

lure

(verb). dụ dỗ

Ex: Young people are lured to the city by the prospect of a job and money.

isolated

(adjective). Cô lập

Ex: isolated rural areas Ex: Unless a compromise could be reached the country would be diplomatically isolated on this issue.

influential

(adjective). có tầm ảnh hưởng

Ex: She is one of the most influential figures in local politics.

illiterate

(adjective). mù chữ

Ex: A surprising percentage of the population is illiterate.

game

(noun). thú săn

Ex: They were very much plant eaters, hunting live game for either the sport or the bones to construct their settlements.

fortunate

(adjective). may mắn

Ex: I have been fortunate enough to visit many parts of the world as a lecturer.

favour

(verb). ủng hộ, thích dùng hơn

Ex: These are the running shoes favoured by marathon runners.

exhaustive

(adjective). bao gồm hết mọi khía cạnh

Ex: exhaustive research/tests Ex: The guide outlines every bus route in exhaustive detail.

exceed

(verb). vượt quá 1 mức nào đó

Ex: Summer temperatures rarely exceed 30°C.

ethnobotanist

(noun). nhà nghiên cứu về thực vật

Ex: Some ethnobotanists and anthropologists are convinced that root and tuber crops were among the first plants to be domesticated.

establish

(verb). Thiết lập

Ex: Let’s establish some ground rules.

entirely

(adverb). hoàn toàn

Ex: The experience was entirely new to me.

enable

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This new programme will enable older people to study at college.

dramatically

(adverb). đầy kịch tính

Ex: Prices have increased dramatically in the last few years.

disturbance

(noun). Sự xáo trộn

Ex: One problem is the disturbance of the local wildlife by tourists.

dignitary

(noun). quan chức

Ex: Several foreign dignitaries attended the ceremony.

concept

(noun). khái niệm, ý tưởng

Ex: the concept that everyone should have equality of opportunity

colleague

(noun). Đồng nghiệp

Ex: We were friends and colleagues for more than 20 years.

blend

(noun). hỗn hợp

Ex: Their music is a blend of jazz and African rhythms.

allow

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This research must be allowed to continue.

aggressive

(adjective). hung hăng

Ex: He gets aggressive when he's drunk.

yield

(verb). sản xuất, mang lại

Ex: The research has yielded useful information.

initial

(adjective). ban đầu

Ex: Her initial response was one of anger.

from scratch

(phrase). từ đầu

Ex: I learned German from scratch in six months.

document

(verb). Ghi nhận, ghi lại

Ex: Urban life in the nineteenth century is well documented.

description

(noun). Sự miêu tả, sự mô tả

Ex: The name means ‘no trees’ and it is an accurate description of the island.

fibre

(noun). Vải sợi; Chất xơ

Ex: Natural fibres such as cotton tend to be cooler.

weigh

(verb). Đo cân nặng

Ex: Chicks were weighed and measured daily.

official

(noun). Viên chức, công chức

Ex: She is the government official in charge of the project.

institute

(noun). viện

Ex: The report was compiled by Germany's five leading economic research institutes

government

(noun). chính phủ

Ex: She is the government official in charge of the project.

contribute

(verb). đóng góp

Ex: We contributed £5 000 to the earthquake fund.

trade

(verb). mua bán, trao đổi

Ex: Our products are now traded worldwide.

harvest

(verb). thu hoạch

Ex: In the US, winter wheat is harvested in the early summer.

conduct

(verb). tiến hành

Ex: Police conducted a thorough search of the building.

plea

(noun). sự cầu xin trợ giúp

Ex: He refused to listen to her tearful pleas.

union

(noun). hiệp hội

Ex: Her debating skills were honed in the students' union.

reference

(noun). sự nói đến, sự nhắc đến

Ex: She made no reference to her illness but only to her future plans.

prosperity

(noun). thịnh vượng

Ex: The war was followed by a long period of peace and prosperity.

exploitation

(noun). sự khai thác

Ex: Turtles are increasingly threatened by human exploitation.

base on

(verb). dựa vào

Ex: What are you basing this theory on?

logging

(noun). việc đốn cây

Ex: The rule changes will allow logging of the last old-growth trees in many of the northwest forests.

factor

(noun). Nhân tố

Ex: The result will depend on a number of different factors.

consumption

(noun). sự tiêu thụ

Ex: Gas and oil consumption always increases in cold weather.

pattern

(noun). Khuôn mẫu

Ex: Wages in both sectors have followed a similar pattern.

illustration

(noun). ví dụ sinh động

Ex: The statistics are a clear illustration of the point I am trying to make.

anecdote

(noun). chuyện vặt, giai thoại

Ex: Cultural differences are not just amusing anecdotes, but can have a real impact with real consequences.

literacy

(noun). trình độ học vấn

Ex: All the children are tested in basic literacy.

contain

(verb). Chứa đựng, bao gồm

Ex: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.

striking

(adjective). Nổi bật, gây choáng ngợp

Ex: She bears a striking resemblance to her older sister.

annual

(adjective). hàng năm

Ex: The 12th annual Music Festival runs from Friday 25th to Monday 28th October.

period

(noun). kỳ, thời kỳ

Ex: The project will run for a six-month trial period.

drop

(verb). giảm

Ex: The water level in the flooded region has finally begun to drop.

consume

(verb). tiêu thụ

Ex: The electricity industry consumes large amounts of fossil fuels.

trap

(verb). bắt vào bẫy

Ex: She survived in the wilderness by eating berries and trapping small animals and birds.

hunt

(verb). săn

Ex: Lions sometimes hunt alone.

yield

(noun). sản lượng, hoa lợi

Ex: a reduction in milk yield

unpredictable

(adjective). Không thể đoán trước

Ex: The result is entirely unpredictable.

thus

(adverb). do đó, theo cách đó

Ex: The universities have expanded, thus allowing many more people the chance of higher education.

reasonable

(adjective). Hợp lý

Ex: As life expectancy increases, it is reasonable to expect that the retirement age will increase too.

make sense

(verb). có nghĩa, hợp lý

Ex: This sentence doesn't make sense.

discover

(verb). Khám phá

Ex: She recently discovered two fungi that were new to science.

conserve

(verb). Bảo quản

Ex: The funds raised will help conserve endangered meadowlands

subsistence

(noun). sự cầm cự

Ex: Many families are living below the level of subsistence.

critical

(adjective). cấp thiết

Ex: Industry leaders are working together to address this critical issue.

contrary

(noun). sự trái ngược

Ex: I was worried that it might be too hard for me but it turned out the contrary was true.

tend

(verb). có xu hướng

Ex: People tend to be happier if they are in a long-term relationship.

potential

(noun). Tiềm năng, triển vọng

Ex: The European marketplace offers excellent potential for increasing sales.

ignore

(verb). Bỏ qua; làm lơ

Ex: I made a suggestion but they chose to ignore it.

focus

(verb). tập trung

Ex: She was distracted and finding it hard to focus.

current

(adjective). hiện tại

Ex: Oil prices are expected to remain at current levels.

commercial

(adjective). mang tính thương mại

Ex: She is developing the commercial side of the organization.

purpose

(noun). mục đích

Ex: Our campaign's main purpose is to raise money.
